title: Gotrade Daily: Costco Beats, but Yields Still Weigh
summary: Costco beat Q4 estimates, but Treasury yields at 2007 highs still weigh on stocks. Your US watchlist for tonight: COST, ORCL, MU, and TLT.
body_markdown:
After the close, **Costco ([COST](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cost/) )** reported fourth-quarter results above estimates. The question for tonight: can good news from one company offset the pressure from rates?


## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[COST](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cost/) -0.91% Thursday, +0.26% after hours EPS of $6.75 beat consensus, but $0.15 came from a one-time tariff refund.


[ORCL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/orcl/) Down more than 3% Thursday Force majeure notice on the Project Jupiter data center in New Mexico.


[MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) Pre-market % to follow Reports on September 30, a read on AI memory demand.


[TLT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tlt/) Pre-market % to follow The 20+ year Treasury ETF, the most rate-sensitive name on the list.


## Tonight's Catalysts


### Costco beats, with a caveat


**Costco ([COST](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cost/) )** posted fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter net sales of $93.9 billion, up 11.2% from a year ago. Comparable sales rose 9.4% and digital sales grew 19.5%. EPS came in at $6.75, but Costco said $0.15 of that came from non-recurring IEEPA tariff refunds. Without it, EPS was about $6.60, still slightly above the roughly $6.53 consensus. The stock rose only 0.26% after hours, a sign the market had already priced in a strong quarter.


### Oracle sends a force majeure notice


**Oracle ([ORCL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/orcl/) )** fell more than 3% after sending a force majeure notice tied to Project Jupiter, the $165 billion New Mexico data center. According to CNBC, the move aims to protect Oracle from higher costs if the project does not come online in 2028. Oracle said the project remains on schedule. Developer partner **Blue Owl ([OWL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/owl/) )** fell 3.6%.
